title: What Seed Art Vaults Is
definition: Seed Art Vaults: vaults preserving art made of seeds.
description:

title: Readiness Estimator: Seed Art Vaults
definition: Estimates Seed Art Vaults readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Seed Art Vaults components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a vault hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Seed Art Vaults Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Seed Art Vaults operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Seed Art Vaults installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 8072 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where seed libraries monitoring, vault logistics redundancy, or germination tests maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Seed Art Vaults Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Seed Art Vaults: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Seed Art Vaults — vaults preserving art made of seeds.

Phase 1 — Prove (seed libraries): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (vault logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (germination tests): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cultural memory): vault hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and museums-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
